consequence.statement: Kafka resources configured with ZooKeeper (spec.zookeeper field set) will be rejected during cluster reconciliation in Strimzi 0.46.0, as ZooKeeper-based cluster support has been removed. Environments running ZooKeeper-based Kafka clusters must migrate to KRaft mode before upgrading.
consequence.remediation: Migrate all ZooKeeper-based Kafka clusters to KRaft (Kraft controller) mode before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46.0. This requires updating Kafka resources to remove the spec.zookeeper configuration and ensure spec.kraft is properly configured.

original.statement: Support for ZooKeeper-based Apache Kafka clusters and for KRaft migration has been removed from Strimzi 0.46.0.

consequence.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 no longer supports ZooKeeper-based Kafka clusters, and migration from ZooKeeper to KRaft is no longer supported either. An environment with ZooKeeper-based clusters must move every cluster to KRaft before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46.0 or newer, because 0.46.0 can neither run nor migrate them.
consequence.remediation: Before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46.0, migrate every ZooKeeper-based Kafka cluster to KRaft while still on a Strimzi version that supports the migration, and finish any migration already in progress.

corrected.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 removed support for ZooKeeper-based Kafka clusters and for ZooKeeper-to-KRaft migration. Every cluster must be running on KRaft before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46.0 or newer.

decision.reason: The upgrade notes [ev-4c2676e4665a] say support for ZooKeeper-based clusters and for migrating from ZooKeeper to KRaft has been removed, and tell operators to "make sure all your clusters are using KRaft before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46.0 or newer". That is a required step before the upgrade, so the kind is migration-required. Neither that note nor the changelog line [ev-628f9c0eccb2] says Kafka resources with spec.zookeeper are rejected during reconciliation, so resource-rejected claims a failure mode the evidence does not state. The class is still mandatory work, so only the consequence kind and statement are wrong.
